sector: lowest spatial-symmetric singlet; no imposed gerade/orbital occupation
Hamiltonian: He = -0.5 sum_i Laplacian_i - sum_iA 1/r_iA + 1/r12; ENN = 1/R; Etotal = Ee + ENN
boundary: isolated open-space molecular integrals; clamped nuclei; no field
representation: standard contracted real spherical Gaussian AO; full symmetric two-spatial-orbital product space
integrals: PySCF 2.12.1 / libcint; no ECP, density fitting, screening cutoff modification, or fitted pair potential
solver: canonical S^-1/2, explicit singlet Hamiltonian, SciPy LAPACK evr lowest two eigenpairs
arithmetic: binary64; no rigorous interval or bit-parity certification
grid_reason: uniform 0.1 bohr over 0.4-4, followed by fixed stretched points; no geometry optimization or known minimum in executor
independent_reference: Pachucki 2010 arXiv:1007.0322v2, Eq.2, Table IV; external postprocessing only

criteria.P1: sampled interior local minimum below 2*isolated-H in same basis; bracket from neighboring samples only
criteria.P2_tail: absolute E(R)-2EH decreases on R=10,12,16,20; finite-range evidence, no infinity proof
criteria.meaning: predeclared pilot diagnostic thresholds, not measured reference uncertainties or final accuracy requirements

failure_policy: preserve failures; stop on executor diagnostic failure; report any reference mismatch without parameter/basis/threshold adjustment
